fingerprint: enable nix-command inside the workflow guard

detail.title: Enable nix-command inside the workflow guard
detail.why_it_matters: The ci-workflow-docs-skip derivation fails before checking its matrix contract in a clean Linux build sandbox. The new subprocess uses the experimental nix eval command, but neither its arguments nor the derivation enable nix-command; the invoking developer or Actions runner's Nix configuration is not a declared sandbox input. Explicitly enabling the feature makes this pure expression evaluation independent of host configuration.
detail.suggested_fix: Invoke nix with --extra-experimental-features nix-command before eval, or set the feature explicitly in this derivation's NIX_CONFIG. Verify the guard with isolated Nix configuration and build checks.x86_64-linux.ci-workflow-docs-skip on Linux.
evidence: tests/check-workflow-docs-skip.sh:277 -- result = subprocess.run(["nix", "eval", "--json", "--expr", expr], text=True, capture_output=True)
flake.nix:1608-1622 declares Python/PyYAML and pkgs.nix as nativeBuildInputs and invokes this script without NIX_CONFIG or explicit experimental features.

Read-only reproduction: env NIX_CONF_DIR=/nonexistent NIX_USER_CONF_FILES=/dev/null NIX_CONFIG= nix eval --json --expr '1' fails with: error: experimental Nix feature 'nix-command' is disabled; add '--extra-experimental-features nix-command' to enable it. This is a native CLI reproduction, not a Linux derivation result.

fingerprint: duplicate containers-auth probe creates parallel maintenance owners

detail.title: Duplicate containers-auth probe creates parallel maintenance owners
detail.why_it_matters: Changes to the containers-auth lifecycle contract now require editing two byte-identical runtime probes, so a correction to permissions, preservation, or dry-run coverage can leave the other platform testing an older contract. The Linux and Darwin suites exercise distinct delivery boundaries and should remain independent, but their shared probe implementation need not be copied. Extracting the probe preserves both executions while giving the assertions one maintenance owner.
detail.suggested_fix: Move the identical authEffects Python body into tests/lib/containers-auth-effects.py and reference that file from both Nix checks. Retain the Linux activation block and Darwin materialized step extraction, and continue running both platform suites.
evidence: Read and compared both complete authEffects definitions: their 37-line Nix blocks are byte-identical, including the fresh-home, dry-run, exact JSON, file/directory mode, and existing-byte preservation assertions.

tests/darwin-outputs.nix:220-221 extracts stepBlock containersAuth from the materialized generation and executes authEffects; tests/podman-containers.nix:239 executes the same probe over authBlock. These callers preserve distinct platform delivery coverage when the probe is shared.

fingerprint: activation harness runs without -u, passing blocks that abort under home manager

detail.title: Activation harness runs without -u, passing blocks that abort under Home Manager
detail.why_it_matters: This harness is now the only runtime proof for the claude, codex-settings, gemini, tokscale and agent-plugins activation blocks. Home Manager runs activation under `set -eu` and `set -o pipefail`, but the harness runs each block with `bash -e` only. A block that reads an unset variable passes every harness assertion here, then aborts the real `home-manager switch` with an 'unbound variable' error. Per the module's own comment, a failure at that point strands linkGeneration, so the user's declared home files are never linked, while CI stays green.
detail.suggested_fix: Run the block under the same shell options Home Manager's activation script uses: `subprocess.run([bash, '-euo', 'pipefail', str(block)], ...)`. Optionally set cwd=str(home) to match HM's `cd $HOME`. This is the same strictness the sibling harnesses in this diff already use: podman-containers/darwin-outputs authEffects use `-euo pipefail` and vscodium uses `-eu`.
evidence: tests/lib/agent-activation.py:56: `env.pop('DRY_RUN', None)`. Live runs are tested with DRY_RUN unset, the same as Home Manager's live runs, where DRY_RUN is only exported for dry runs.

home/h82/agents/agent-plugins.nix:203: `if [[ -v DRY_RUN ]]; then`. This is the -u-safe form; a refactor to `[ -n "$DRY_RUN" ]` would expand to empty under `bash -e`, take the live branch, and satisfy every call/args/Pi-link/refusal assertion plus the dry-run pass. Under HM's `set -u` the same line aborts activation.

home/h82/agents/agent-plugins.nix:257-259: 'linkGeneration sits behind these entries in the built activation script, so this position keeps a refusal from stranding installPackages but not from stranding linkGeneration' — so a -u abort here leaves home files unlinked.

Same diff, tests/podman-containers.nix authEffects: `subprocess.run(["bash", "-euo", "pipefail", "-c", ...])`, and tests/vscodium.nix: `${pkgs.bash}/bin/bash -eu "$redirected"`. The shared harness is the weakest of the new execution harnesses.

fingerprint: restore the independent no-embedded-credentials activation contract

detail.title: Restore the independent no-embedded-credentials activation contract
detail.suggested_fix: Retain the new effect probes and restore an independent credential-free activation-artifact assertion over the actual block, with a fake embedded-token negative control; avoid matching incidental store-path hashes.
detail.why_it_matters: The diff deletes the independent check forbidding embedded auths/token/password data in the world-readable activation artifact. The replacement only checks the created auth.json and preserved target bytes, so a credential embedded elsewhere in the block is no longer rejected. R4 requires retaining independent security contracts.
evidence: git diff 09e9f5aaf56f3bb549c69bc8499de9c208737e4d -- tests/podman-containers.nix removes the activationScriptData no-embedded-token assertion.
tests/podman-containers.nix:24-60 inspects fresh auth.json, dry-run state, modes and existing bytes, without inspecting embedded credentials in the activation block.
Plan R4 retains every named independent contract.
